overall_comment: Imaging strongly suggests an IDH‑mutant astrocytoma without 1p/19q codeletion, graded as WHO III. The unusually high edema proportion and lack of advanced imaging (diffusion, perfusion, spectroscopy) limit certainty; molecular confirmation is recommended.
